risk_of_bias.confounding_reverse_causation: agree: internal GMM instruments are offered for simultaneity but with 18 instruments for 24 countries, one control per model and several models failing AR(2)/Hansen, exogeneity is not credibly established while conclusions are phrased causally.
risk_of_bias.exposure_measurement: agree: subscriptions per 100 people (WDI) is a standard but crude diffusion proxy (mobile max 142.98).
risk_of_bias.selection_of_countries_years: agree: 25 SSA countries chosen on data availability, only five 7-year averages (82-96 observations).
risk_of_bias.outcome_measurement: agree: PWT TFP indices are acceptable, but 'real TFP growth' has identical mean (0.539) to TFP in Appendix A2 and Table 4 header is garbled, so the outcome definitions are unclear.
risk_of_bias.specification: agree: serious because a single control per model, 40 models, quadratic terms with thresholds derived post hoc, and inconsistent net-effect/threshold cells.
risk_of_bias.selective_reporting: agree: all columns are printed, but headline thresholds rest on selected columns and text column references do not match the tables.
risk_of_bias.why: Causal language, weak identification with tiny N and T, one-control-at-a-time models and post hoc thresholds make serious the right overall rating.

problems: No invented or mixed-up content found. Only substantive correction is result 3 (internet quadratic terms are significant at 10% in col 7 and 5% in col 9). Record notes about 25 vs 24 countries, the 'second column' and 'seventh column' citation mismatches, and 17.5 vs 15.000 are all accurate. Minor: record says many columns fail AR(2)/Hansen; in Table 1 only a few do (e.g. AR(2) 0.053 col 4, Hansen 0.063 col 2 and 0.072 col 8 at 10%), failures are more common in Tables 2 and 4 (Sargan).
